description: Google Play Console rejection patterns and compliance rules based on real rejection experiences

rejectionReasons.details: Featured graphic contained promotional content or text not allowed by Google Play policies
rejectionReasons.fix: Remove promotional text, rankings, testimonials from featured graphic

rejectionReasons.details: Description contained 'Trusted by 5000+ Clients' which violates metadata policy against user testimonials and user counts
rejectionReasons.fix: Remove all user counts, testimonials, and social proof claims from description

rejectionReasons.details: App provides government information (tax filing) but lacks clear URL links to original government sources (.gov domains)
rejectionReasons.fix: Add source links to official government websites and include disclaimer that app doesn't represent government entity

rejectionReasons.details: Health features in app don't match information provided in health declaration. Must declare all applicable categories: Reproductive/Sexual Health, Activity/Fitness, Nutrition, Period Tracking, Stress Management, Diseases Management, Healthcare Services, Medical Reference, Medication Management
rejectionReasons.fix: Update Health apps declaration form to select ALL applicable health feature categories

rejectionReasons.details: App exhibited crashes or broken functionality during review
rejectionReasons.fix: Test app thoroughly on multiple devices, check Android vitals, fix all crash issues

rejectionReasons.details: App was removed from Play Store due to missing Data safety form
rejectionReasons.fix: Complete Data safety form in Play Console before submission

rejectionReasons.details: App title and/or description don't accurately reflect app functionality
rejectionReasons.fix: Update title and description to accurately describe current app functionality

rejectionReasons.details: Privacy policy URL doesn't link to a valid, accessible privacy policy. Must be active, publicly accessible, non-geofenced URL (no PDFs)
rejectionReasons.fix: Ensure privacy policy URL is accessible globally, not a PDF, and contains comprehensive privacy information

rejectionReasons.details: Data safety form not completed in Play Console
rejectionReasons.fix: Complete Data safety form with ALL data types collected by app

rejectionReasons.details: Screenshots shown in store listing don't accurately represent current app functionality
rejectionReasons.fix: Update screenshots to show actual current app screens and features

rejectionReasons.details: App requests access to photos/images without prominent disclosure explaining why access is needed
rejectionReasons.fix: Add prominent in-app disclosure before requesting photo/camera permissions explaining purpose

rejectionReasons.details: Screenshots shown in store listing don't match actual app UI/functionality
rejectionReasons.fix: Replace screenshots with actual current app screens

rejectionReasons.details: News/magazine app lacks accessible contact information required by policy
rejectionReasons.fix: Add accessible contact information (email, website, phone) in app and store listing

rejectionReasons.details: Store listing screenshots show features or UI that don't exist in app
rejectionReasons.fix: Update screenshots to reflect only actual implemented features

rejectionReasons.details: App installed successfully but failed to load or display content
rejectionReasons.fix: Test app startup on multiple devices, ensure app loads and responds within reasonable time

rejectionReasons.issue: Device IDs not disclosed in data safety
rejectionReasons.details: App collects device IDs but this was not disclosed in Data safety form
rejectionReasons.fix: Update Data safety form to include device identifiers in data collection disclosure

rejectionReasons.issue: Device IDs not disclosed in data safety
rejectionReasons.details: App collects device IDs but this was not disclosed in Data safety form
rejectionReasons.fix: Update Data safety form to include device identifiers in data collection disclosure

rejectionReasons.details: App installed successfully but failed to load or display content
rejectionReasons.fix: Test app startup on multiple devices, ensure app loads within 5 seconds

broken_functionality.name: Broken Functionality
broken_functionality.description: App crashes, doesn't load, or functions abnormally
rules: Test app on 3+ real devices before submission
Ensure app loads within 5 seconds
Test all user flows end-to-end
Check Android vitals for crash reports
Test on minimum supported Android version
Verify network connectivity handling
Test offline functionality if applicable

data_safety.name: Data Safety & Privacy
data_safety.description: Data safety form, privacy policy, and user data handling
rules: Complete Data safety form in Play Console BEFORE submission
Disclose ALL data types including device IDs and analytics
Privacy policy URL must be accessible globally (not geofenced)
Privacy policy CANNOT be a PDF file
Add prominent disclosure for sensitive data access
Request runtime permissions before accessing data
Include device identifiers if using Firebase/analytics

metadata.name: Metadata Policy
metadata.description: App title, description, screenshots, icons, and graphics
rules: Screenshots MUST match current app version exactly
NO user testimonials or user counts in description
NO store performance claims (Best, #1, Top, Leading)
NO promotional language (Free, Discount, Sale, New)
Title must be 30 characters or less
NO emojis in title, icon, or developer name
Description must accurately describe app functionality
Feature graphic must not contain promotional text

misleading_claims.name: Misleading Claims
misleading_claims.description: False claims about app functionality or affiliations
rules: Provide source links for ALL government information
Include disclaimer if not government-affiliated
Screenshots must match actual current app UI
Don't claim features that don't exist
Don't claim affiliation without proper authorization
Update screenshots after every app update

health_apps.name: Health Content & Services
rules: Complete Health apps declaration accurately in Play Console
Select ALL applicable health categories
Include medical disclaimer if not a medical device
App must NOT diagnose/treat/cure without authorization
Provide comprehensive health data privacy policy
Categories: Reproductive, Activity, Nutrition, Period Tracking, Stress, Diseases, Healthcare Services, Medical Reference, Medication Management

news_apps.name: News & Magazine Apps
rules: Provide accessible contact information in app AND store listing
Include source attribution for all articles
Disclose if news is aggregated from third parties
Update content regularly

user_data.name: User Data Policy
user_data.description: Collection and handling of user data
rules: Prominent disclosure BEFORE accessing photos/camera/files
Runtime permission request before data access
Clear explanation of WHY data is needed
User consent required before collection
Disclosure must be visible and not hidden in settings

beforeSubmission: App tested on 3+ real devices without crashes
App loads and responds within 5 seconds
Data safety form complete with ALL data types
Device IDs disclosed if using Firebase/analytics
Privacy policy URL accessible globally (not PDF)
Screenshots match current app version EXACTLY
Title is 30 characters or less, no emojis
Feature graphic has no promotional text
Government sources linked with disclaimer (if applicable)
privacyCheck: Privacy policy URL works and loads globally
Privacy policy is NOT a PDF
Data safety form complete in Play Console
ALL data types disclosed (including device IDs)
Prominent disclosure for sensitive data access
healthAppsCheck: ALL health categories selected that apply
Medical disclaimer included if not a medical device
Health data handling disclosed in privacy policy
